sql: SELECT 'cadastro' AS fonte, l.n, l.line FROM ai_agent_settings s JOIN companies c ON c.id = s.company_id, LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(s.extra_instructions, E'\n')) WITH ORDINALITY AS l(line, n) WHERE c.name = 'Castelo da Diversão' AND l.line ~* '(lembranc|topo de bolo|decora|personaliz|brinde|vamu|3d|souvenir|kit)' UNION ALL SELECT 'ensinado', 0, o.text FROM ai_owner_notes o JOIN companies c ON c.id = o.company_id WHERE c.name = 'Castelo da Diversão' AND o.text ~* '(lembranc|topo de bolo|decora|personaliz|brinde|vamu|souvenir)'
